Screen 2A - Residency Detection

Tell us about yourself and your time spent in India to automatically determine your tax residency status.

💡
Global Annual Application
Unlike income which is strictly tracked per quarter, your tax residency status and age profile apply to the entire Tax Year. Any information entered here is treated as global for the year and cannot be different across quarters.
⚠️
Dual Residency Conflict Detected You are classified as a tax resident under both Indian domestic laws (Fiscal Year: Apr–Mar) and US domestic laws (Calendar Year: Jan–Dec). This creates overlapping worldwide tax exposure.
DTAA Article 4 Tie-Breaker

Under the India-US Treaty, you can resolve dual residency by breaking the tie to one country using these sequential tests: Permanent Home ➔ Center of Vital Interests ➔ Habitual Abode ➔ Nationality. Breaking the tie to the US allows you to file your Indian return as a Non-Resident and claim DTAA benefits.

Tax Year Mismatch & FTC Apportionment

If you do not break the tie, you must claim a Foreign Tax Credit (FTC Form 67 / Section 90) to avoid double taxation in India. Because the Indian Fiscal Year (April-March) crosses two US Calendar Years, you must apportion US calendar-year earnings and withholdings to the corresponding Indian fiscal months.

Run the Treaty Tie-Breaker Tests

AMT Credit Brought Forward — Alternate Minimum Tax (AMT) Old Regime Only
AMT credit is not applicable under the New Regime (Section 202). Switch to Old Regime to enter AMT credit carried forward.
What is AMT Credit? If in a prior year your Alternate Minimum Tax (18.5% of Adjusted Total Income) exceeded your normal income tax, you paid the higher AMT. The excess paid over normal tax is accumulated as AMT credit under Alternate Minimum Tax (AMT) Credit Carry Forward. This credit can be carried forward for up to 15 assessment years and set off in any future year where your normal tax exceeds AMT. Unused credit that exceeds the 15-year window lapses permanently.

Max deduction ₹3,00,000 for authors of certain books.

Max deduction ₹3,00,000 for royalty on patents.

Education Loan Interest Deduction — Interest on Education Loan

Deductible for interest paid on loans taken for higher education of self, spouse, children, or students for whom you are the legal guardian. No upper limit on deduction; valid for up to 8 years.

Affordable Housing Loan Interest Deduction / First-Time Homebuyer Loan Interest Deduction — Additional Home Loan Interest

Additional interest deduction over and above Section 24(b). Derived automatically based on loan sanction date window.
